Portrait 9:16 cinematic dimensional storybook-animation, luxury outdoor mountain-to-beach wedding. Preserve adult Indian faces, medium-brown skin and natural proportions. DRAMATIC LIGHT: diagonal volumetric sunshafts through waterfall or sea mist, deep sculpted shade, bright fabric rim light, moving caustic reflections; at night cyan moonbeams balance amber practical pools. Modern coastal typography: elegant editorial serif with restrained handwritten accents, pearl-white headlines, deep ocean-teal body copy, brushed-platinum edges, fine cyan glow; no ornate antique lettering. Distinct natural locations, expensive site-specific decor. Cars are parked, wheels fixed; everyone has planted feet. Only camera, environment and subtle gestures move. Tiny mist beads, windborne grass seeds or coastal bubbles hang at varied depths, never a confetti storm. Text-only image, no watermark or extra words.

SCENE COMPOSITION:
Night reception on an open-air dining deck outside ONE small weathered beach shack in the crescent bay. Never enter its interior. A navy sky, moonlit waves and open sand remain visible across most of the background. Warm festoon bulbs and low jar lanterns light layered pearl linens, crystal place settings and lavish coastal orchid arrangements; no overhead decorative frame. ONE ivory reception card on a simple driftwood easel occupies the central 60 percent of width with frame and legs visible. Exact lettering: 'Reception - Dinner
6th February 2020
7:30 p.m. onwards
Leela Channaiah
Kalyana Mandapa
Vontikoppal, Mysore'. Deep-teal letter faces with a luminous pearl-white title and platinum edges, readable against warm ivory. The shack sits partly outside frame LEFT, with weathered boards as a local detail; the sea extends open RIGHT. A few guests sit already in chairs at the far tables, feet fixed, tiny facial gestures only; nobody walks. The distant rocky headland has the same silhouette as the earlier scene. Grounded orchids, shells and silk runners remain fixed. Sparse backlit bubbles and sea-spray beads drift in cyan moonshafts and amber practical light. A sandy arrival path extends to the side where hosts will welcome guests.
